scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
They say the
famous dance school
here in Comodo is going
to open soon.
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索诺托拉]
听说，克魔岛那所著名的舞蹈学校就要开学了。

scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
Aah...
To be a prima donna
in the spotlight!
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索诺托拉]
啊...
成为聚光灯下的首席舞者！

scripts.text:
[Athena Sonotora]
I want to sign up too,
but the requirements are
so specific. I wonder if
I should just try anyways...
scripts.translation:
[雅典娜·索诺托拉]
我也想报名，可条件定得很细。
要不，还是去试试看...

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Aah....
A prima donna
in the spotlight!
I'll be able to watch them become Dancers right before my eyes...!
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
啊...
聚光灯下的首席舞者！
我能亲眼看着她们成为舞娘...！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
It's great to be
a man in this day and age! Hurray for the Comodo Theater!
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
活在这个时代，做个男人真好！
克魔岛剧场万岁！

scripts.text:
[Bor Robin]
Mm?
You want
to go, too?
It's a good opportunity to watch the Dancer job change test.
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
嗯？你也想去？
这可是观看舞娘转职考验的好机会。

scripts.text: Go to the Job Change Area

[Bor Robin]
Huh...
Well, I can't
help it if you don't
want to accompany me.
scripts.translation:
[博尔·罗宾]
唉...
你不想陪我去，那也没办法。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
One two three four,
Two two three four,
three four, three four,
one two three four.
Um?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
一二三四，
二二三四，
三四三四，
一二三四。
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I'm sorry, but you're interrupting my practice by looking at me funny.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
抱歉，你用那种奇怪的眼神看着我，打扰到我练习了。

[艾尔]
.......
.....嘿，我以前是不是见过你？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Err...
That's weird, I can't remember where I've seen you.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
呃...
奇怪，想不起在哪儿见过你了。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
Let me know
if you have any new songs. We can always use some new music to complement our performances.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢迎~！
有新歌的话，记得告诉我。
我们的表演，总需要些新音乐来配合。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
How are you
these days?
Do many people enjoy
your performances?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢迎~！
最近怎么样？
喜欢你表演的人多吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, only authorized personnel can come here. Not just anyone can enter the Dance School.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢——嗯？
嘿，只有获准的人才能进来。
舞蹈学校可不是谁都能进的。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
If you want to watch, why don't you go to the Dance Stage in town?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
想看表演，不如去镇上的舞台？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcome~!
This is the
'Comodo Dance School,'
where we teach various dances from different countries. We provide entertainement for travelers from all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢迎~！
这里是“克魔岛舞蹈学校”，教授各国的舞蹈，也为来自世界各地的旅人带来欢乐。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
We also provide the opportunity for aspiring Dancers to become famous throughout the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! Doesn't dancing in the spotlight sound spectacular?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我们也为胸怀梦想的舞娘提供机会，让她们名扬卢恩·米德加兹王国！
在聚光灯下起舞，是不是很令人向往？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I think it's fair to let you know that our school is selective. So we don't accept students who don't seem to have the talent to become Dancers.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
得先告诉你，我们招生是有筛选的。
没有舞蹈天赋的学生，我们可不会收。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
What do you think?
Do you want to sign up? You only have to write a couple of things on the application, and you can just come to the lessons once or twice and try it out.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
怎么样，想报名吗？
申请表只需填几项，先来上一两节课，试试看也行。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
So what do
you want to do~?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
那么，你打算怎么办~？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Good choice!!
Just fill out the application right there.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
选得好！
就在那边填申请表吧。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Your name is
{0}?
Wow! What a pretty name! Just a moment, I have to show this to the director, so come back in a little bit, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
你叫{0}？
哇，名字真好听！
稍等，我得把申请表给总监看看，过会儿再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Mmm...
It seems that
you aren't quite qualified to enroll in our school yet. You need to be at least Job Level 40.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
嗯...你还不符合入学条件。
职业等级至少要达到40级。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Well, I hope
that you apply
again when you meet
the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
希望你符合条件后，再来申请。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Aww~
Just think about it.
Don't forget to come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
哎呀~再考虑一下吧。
改变主意的话，别忘了回来哦。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, this place is only for authorized personnel. If you want to sing, you should go look into being a Bard.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢——嗯？
嘿，这里只有获准的人才能进来。
想唱歌的话，不如考虑成为诗人。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Not all Archers
can become Dancers.
At least, not without some sort of sex change~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
可不是所有弓箭手都能成为舞娘。
至少，不变个性是没办法的~

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Good.
Since you signed up earlier, I'll let you know some things you'll need to bring for your lessons.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
好，你之前已经报名了。
现在说说，上课需要带些什么。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
We're short on some supplies, but you'll be using them for yourself anyway. Just think of it as part of the tuition, so don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我们有些用品不够，不过，反正都是你自己要用的。
就当学费的一部分，不必太担心。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, you'll about ^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000 for shoe polish.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
首先，学费是^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000。
还需要^CD688920个粘稠液体^000000，用来擦鞋。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Then, bring ^CD68893 Jellopy^000000 and ^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 to use as ointment. And of course, you'll need a pair of ^CD6889Shoes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
再带^CD68893个杰勒比结晶^000000和^CD68895个红色药水^000000，用作药膏。
当然，还得有一双^CD6889长靴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Once again, that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000,
^CD68893 Jellopy^000000,
^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 and
^CD68891 Shoes^000000.

[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 for polishing the floor and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Boots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
首先，学费是^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000。
再带^CD68895个蚯蚓皮^000000，用来擦地板。
当然，还需要一双^CD6889靴子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Once again that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 and 
^CD68891 Boots^000000.

[Aile]
First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000 for your costume, ^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000 and ^CD688920 Jellopy^000000 to treat foot injuries.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
首先，学费是^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000。
再带^CD68892个蛤蜊外壳^000000，制作服装；以及^CD68895个黄色药水^000000和^CD688920个杰勒比结晶^000000，治疗脚伤。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
You'll also need to bring ^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 to make wigs for the performances and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Sandals^000000. Once again, that's...
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
还需要^CD688910个长发^000000，制作演出用的假发。
当然，也得带一双^CD6889轻便鞋^000000。
再说一遍，就是...

scripts.text:
[Aile]
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000,
^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000,
^CD688920 Jellopy^000000,
^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 and
^CD6889Sandals^000000.

[Aile]
Once you've gathered everything that you need, come back so that we can begin the lessons, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
东西备齐后，就回来开始上课，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Oh...!
You brought
everything!
Alright then,
let me take your
tuition fee.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
哦...！全带齐了！
好，那我收下学费。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Next, go to ^CD6889Bijou^000000, who is in charge of the interviewing process. She will have a couple of things she'll need to ask you.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
接下来，去找负责面试的^CD6889碧珠^000000。
她有几个问题要问你。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Mmm...?
You don't have
everything yet?
Let me remind you
so you can bring
what you need next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
嗯...？还没带齐？
我再提醒一遍，下次记得备齐。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Hmm...?
Are you having
trouble finding
^CD6889Bijou^000000?

[Aile]
You need to talk to her because she's in charge of the interviewing process. Don't worry, she should be somewhere here in the Dance School.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
她负责面试，你得去找她谈谈。
别担心，她就在舞蹈学校里。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
I'll be looking
forward to a great
performance~
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
我期待你的精彩演出~

scripts.text:
[Aile]
Welcom--Hm?
Hey, only authorized
personnel are allowed
in here.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
欢——嗯？
嘿，只有获准的人才能进来。

scripts.text:
[Aile]
If you want to watch, be quiet and don't disturb the performers. Everyone here is busy practicing so that they can become fine Dancers.
scripts.translation:
[艾尔]
想看的话，保持安静，不要打扰表演者。
大家正忙着练习，努力成为优秀的舞娘。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
技能点没用完，就不能转职。
先把剩余技能点用完，再回来。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Welcome~
Ooh, a Bard! Do you have any new songs to show us? We can always use some musical accompaniment for our dances.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
欢迎~
哦，是诗人！有新歌想唱给我们听吗？
我们的舞蹈，总需要些音乐伴奏。

[碧珠]
哎呀...！
欢迎回来~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
How are you
these days?
A lot of people
must love watching
you dance. Are you
enjoying the spotlight?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你最近过得怎么样？
一定有很多人喜欢看你跳舞吧。
享受成为众人焦点的感觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh dear~
You seem to have traveled quite a distance to watch me perform.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
看来你为了看我的表演，特地赶了很远的路呢。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I'm sorry, but I've retired. Now I'm focusing on training new Dancers. If you go to the Center Stage, you can watch my students~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
抱歉，我已经退休了。
现在专心培养新舞娘。
去中央舞台就能看到我的学生表演哦~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
你想成为舞娘，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
I know you're excited, but the first step is the application. Go over to the left side of the stage where Aile can help you with that.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
我知道你很兴奋，不过得先报名。
去舞台左侧找艾尔，她会帮你办理手续。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀~
你想成为舞娘，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
G-goodness!
Look at that stomach fat!
Well, it's not much, so you'll lose it in no time. Especially since I'll be handling your training~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
天、天哪！
看看你肚子上的赘肉！
不过也不多，很快就能减掉的。
何况还有我亲自指导你训练呢~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Still...
The idea of the
perfect body sure
has changed since
I was young. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
不过...
如今人们心目中的完美身材，跟我年轻时可真不一样了。
总之...

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's start
with the interview.
I'm only going to ask
a couple of simple things
so don't worry~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
先从面试开始吧。
我只会问几个简单的问题，别担心~

[碧珠]
好的...
我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh, you're back~
Have you studied
some more? Try to
pass this time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哦，你回来了~
又好好复习过了吗？
这次争取通过，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
1. The Dancer's dance, ^CD6889Lady Luck^000000,
increases which of the following?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 舞娘的技能^CD6889女神之吻^000000能提升以下哪项属性？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. Of the following,
which can you not consider
to be a dance?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 以下哪一项不属于舞蹈？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
3. Which of the following
best describes a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 以下哪项最能描述舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. Which of the following
cannot be associated with Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 以下哪项与克魔岛无关？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. Before Comodo, what is the region name of the region NorthEast of Pharoah's Lighthouse Island?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 在到达克魔岛之前，法老灯塔岛东北方向的地区叫什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. Who is the most
beautiful dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 谁是最美丽的舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

[Bijou]
7. Of the following,
who can perform together
with a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 以下谁可以和舞娘一起表演？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. Which of the following
is not a specialty of Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 以下哪项不是克魔岛的特色？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
9. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
9. 谁是克魔岛赌场的管理员？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
10. Who accepts the
Dancer job change
applications?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
10. 谁负责受理舞娘的转职申请？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
1. What is the effect
of the combined skill,
^CD6889Mental Sensing^000000?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 合奏技能^CD6889经验值倍增^000000有什么效果？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. Which is considered
bad etiquette on the dance
floor after a dance?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 跳完舞后，在舞池里做什么会显得不礼貌？

scripts.text: Ask to dance a different dance.

[Bijou]
3. Which is not an
appropriate response
when someone makes
a mistake while you
are dancing together?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 一起跳舞时，如果对方出错了，以下哪种反应不恰当？

scripts.text: Smile at each other and continue dancing.
Ignore it if the dancer does not realize it.
scripts.translation: 对方没察觉就当作没发生

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. In which town
can you change jobs
to a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 在哪个城镇可以转职为舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. How many dungeons
are directly connected
to Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 有多少个地下城与克魔岛直接相连？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
6. Which of the following
is not a Cute Pet monster?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 以下哪种魔物不能成为宠物？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Who is the most
graceful dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 谁是最优雅的舞娘？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

[Bijou]
8. What is the
exact name of the
Kafra in Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 克魔岛的卡普拉职员全名是什么？

scripts.text: Casts the Blind effect in the area.
Casts the Sleep effect on the area.
Puts a night effect on the area.

[Bijou]
1. What is the effect
of the skill ^CD6889Dance Lessons^000000?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
1. 技能^CD6889练习舞蹈^000000的效果是什么？

scripts.text: Increases the effect of dancing skills
Inflict Stun on a certain area around the caster.
scripts.translation: 使施法者周围一定范围内的目标眩晕

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
2. What dance uses shoes
that are designed to make
sound as the dancer rolls
their feet and taps the
ground to create a rhythm?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
2. 哪种舞蹈穿着特制的鞋子，通过脚部的转动和踏地发出声音，打出节奏？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
3. Which of the following
is not a characteristic of a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
3. 以下哪项不是舞娘的特征？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
4. Which town has
the most Dancers?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
4. 哪个城镇的舞娘最多？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
5. Of the following,
who dances most beautifully?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
5. 以下谁跳舞最优美？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

[Bijou]
6. What is the Dancer
better at than the other
job classes?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
6. 与其他职业相比，舞娘更擅长什么？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
7. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
7. 克魔岛赌场的管理员是谁？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
8. What item cannot
be equipped by a Dancer?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
8. 舞娘无法装备以下哪件物品？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
9. Do you think you
can say this quiz is
frustrating and annoying?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
9. 你觉得可以说这场测验让人烦躁、讨厌吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
10. Which of the following
is not a Jazz musician?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
10. 以下哪位不是爵士乐音乐家？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Good job~
It seems like you
answered all the
questions~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
做得好~
看来你已经答完所有问题了~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
Very well done!
A perfect score!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我看看...
你的得分是 {0} 分...
非常棒！
满分！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
It wasn't perfect, but I'll let you pass.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我看看...
你的得分是 {0} 分...
虽然没拿到满分，不过还是让你通过吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
You.. You failed!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
让我看看...
你的得分是 {0} 分...
你...你没通过！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
There aren't too many people who apply for the Dancer job with this kind of knowledge. I'm sorry for judging you by your looks~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
来报名转职舞娘的人，像你这样知识丰富的可不多。
抱歉，刚才以貌取人了~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Whew~
Now you only have the Dance Test. While we prepare the test, why don't you rest a bit? Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
呼~
现在只剩舞蹈测试了。
趁我们准备测试，你先休息一下吧？
Ho ho ho~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Was it too hard?
When I was young, everyone knew at least enough to pass this test. Go and study some more before coming back, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
太难了吗？
我年轻的时候，这些都是人人都懂的知识，足够通过测试了。
回去再好好学习一下再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Okay...
Are you ready
for the Dance Test?
If you like, I can
explain the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
好...
准备好参加舞蹈测试了吗？
需要的话，我可以先讲讲规则。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
First of all, each person gets ^CD68891 minute^000000 for the test, and everyone dances ^CD6889one at a time^000000. Don't worry if you've never danced before~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
首先，每个人的测试时间是^CD68891分钟^000000，而且^CD6889每次只考一人^000000。
就算以前没跳过舞，也不用担心~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Once you enter the testing area, you will see the stage. First, ^CD6889change your camera angle so that it faces forward^000000. It will probably work if you ^CD6889double-click on the right mouse button^000000.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
进入测试区域后，你会看到舞台。
首先，^CD6889调整视角，让镜头朝向正前方^000000。
一般^CD6889双击鼠标右键^000000就可以了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
If you don't reset your camera angle, you may get the ^CD6889Up, Down, Left, Right^000000 commands confused.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
如果不重置视角，你可能会搞混^CD6889上、下、左、右^000000的指令。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Wait for your turn in the ^CD6889waiting room^000000. If the person in front of you fails, or if it's your turn in line, your test will begin.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
请在^CD6889候考室^000000等候。
前面的人测试失败，或是排到你时，你的测试就会开始。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
If there are a lot of people, not everyone might fit in the waiting room. If that's the case, just create an orderly line~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
人多的话，候考室可能容不下所有人。
这时请大家有序排队~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
When the test begins, the music will be broadcast, as well as the direction in which you should move. Just follow the instructions and move your legs.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
测试开始后，会播放音乐，同时告诉你该往哪个方向移动。
跟着指令迈步就行了。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Remember, ^CD6889you will be disqualified if you don't perform the steps with the right timing^000000. Be careful, the test is very strict~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
记住，^CD6889如果没有在正确的时机迈出舞步，就会被取消资格^000000。
要小心，测试的判定很严格哦~

[碧珠]
那么~
祝你好运...!!

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my...
Did you
fail last time?
Don't worry, just
try to feel the rhythm~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀...
上次没通过吗？
别担心，试着感受节奏吧~

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
还有未分配的技能点就不能转职。
先把剩余的技能点用完再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Oh my...
I saw your
dance earlier.
You were great!
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
哎呀...
刚才我看了你的舞蹈。
跳得真棒！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Your performance shows that you are than qualified to become a Dancer. Well then, let me change your job.
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
你的表现证明，你完全有资格成为舞娘。
那么，我来为你转职吧。

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
With the blessing of our goddess, you shall be reborn as a Dancer. From now on, no one will leave your presense without a smile~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
在女神的祝福下，你将以舞娘的身份迎来新生。
从今往后，所有人都会带着笑容离开你的身边~

scripts.text:
Ooh...!
You look great
as a Dancer~
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
Ooh...!
你成为舞娘的样子真美~
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Bijou]
Here's a small
gift from me.
Please take it.
May your performances always bring joy to your audience~
scripts.translation:
[碧珠]
这是我送你的一份小礼物。
请收下。
愿你的表演总能为观众带来欢乐~

scripts.text:
[Pyorgin]
Please wait in
the waiting room.
Click the Chatroom
box to enter.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥尔金]
请在候考室等候。
点击聊天室窗口即可进入。

scripts.text:
[Pyorgin]
Also, those who
are curious about
the test can watch
backstage.
scripts.translation:
[皮奥尔金]
另外，想了解测试的人也可以在后台观看。
